name: Xcode DerivedData
summary: Build products and indexes Xcode keeps for each project.
afterEffect: The next build of each project starts from scratch and takes longer.

name: Xcode device support
summary: Debug symbols copied from devices you have connected.
afterEffect: Xcode copies them again the next time you connect that device.

name: Simulator caches
summary: Shared caches used by the iOS simulators.
afterEffect: Simulators take longer to boot the first time.

name: Xcode archives
summary: Archived app builds, including the debug symbols for versions you shipped.
afterEffect: You can no longer symbolicate crash reports for those builds or re-export them.

name: Swift Package Manager cache
afterEffect: Packages download again on the next resolve. Needs a connection.

name: CocoaPods cache
afterEffect: Pods download again on the next pod install. Needs a connection.

name: npm cache
afterEffect: Packages download again on the next install. Needs a connection.

name: Yarn cache
afterEffect: Packages download again on the next install. Needs a connection.

name: pnpm store
summary: Shared package store used by pnpm projects.
afterEffect: Packages download again on the next install. Needs a connection.

name: Gradle caches
summary: Downloaded dependencies and build caches for Gradle and Android builds.
afterEffect: Dependencies download again and the next build is slower. Needs a connection.

name: Homebrew downloads
summary: Installers Homebrew downloaded for things already installed.
afterEffect: Nothing to redo. Installed tools keep working.

name: Dart and Flutter package cache
afterEffect: Packages download again on the next pub get. Needs a connection.

name: Cargo registry cache
afterEffect: Crates download again on the next build. Needs a connection.

name: Go build cache
summary: Compiled packages cached by the Go toolchain.
afterEffect: The next Go build recompiles everything and takes longer.
